S1D1_TIERS.description: tier names and upper bounds your gateway sends, e.g. TRIVIAL=0.15,LOW=0.4,MEDIUM=0.7,HIGH=0.9,EXPERT=1.0

S1D1_DEADLINE_MS.description: shed a request when its expected wait exceeds this

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: optional: OpenTelemetry collector URL for traces and metrics; empty = no export

S1D1_API_KEY.description: bearer key for the adapter routes, generated for you
